$comment: The canonical MENA food catalog, and the only thing `db:seed:catalog` reads. Curated by hand: slug, nameAr, nameEn, state, category, sourceType, sourceRef, aliasesAr, aliasesEn. Generated by `db:build-catalog` from data/usda-sr-legacy.ndjson: note (the source description, re-checked at seed time), nutrition (per 100 g, verbatim, an unmeasured nutrient written as an explicit null and never as 0), portions (the food's own measured household portion and plain fractions of it), and checksum. Aliases are search-only synonyms and are never displayed as a food's name. Note: مفتول is deliberately NOT an alias for couscous — they are different foods, and this catalog holds no maftoul nutrition.
